selection_rationale: Highest tourney_score (190.2), highest sim_p99 (232.6), highest ceil_ev (209.6), and lowest dup_risk (0.54) of all 20 JEV-simulated lineups. All 20 were London-free; #5 dominated on every axis. Winner-take-all 50-man = maximize ceiling, minimize duplication.
stack: SEA Lock + JSN (2-man QB stack); MIN@NO game stack (Mason vs Olave+Fant double runback); LV Bowers + Raiders DST team pair

lineup.name: Drew Lock
lineup.why: Minimum-salary QB ($4K) stacked with JSN — the salary relief that funds three elite pass-catchers; 27.4 ceiling at near-zero ownership (1.7%).

lineup.name: Jordan Mason
lineup.why: $4K RB with GSE 86 vs NO; second salary-saver that keeps the stars affordable, 19.0 ceiling if the MIN run game hits.

lineup.name: Kyle Monangai
lineup.why: GSE 95 at $5.2K — lead-back volume vs GB with a 26.1 ceiling; best points-per-dollar RB on the slate.

lineup.name: Jaxon Smith-Njigba
lineup.why: Slate's highest ceiling (50.2) and a perfect GSE 100; the alpha WR1 paired with his QB for correlated spike weeks vs SF.

lineup.name: Nico Collins
lineup.why: GSE 99, 44.0 ceiling vs TEN — elite alpha WR1 in a soft matchup; bring-back-free standalone ceiling piece.

lineup.name: Chris Olave
lineup.why: GSE 99, 39.7 ceiling; NO pass-game double with Fant creates correlated MIN@NO game exposure from the NO side.

lineup.name: Brock Bowers
lineup.why: Perfect GSE 100 TE, 41.0 ceiling vs NE — positional slate-breaker; TEs who can outscore WR1s win GPPs.

lineup.name: Noah Fant
lineup.why: $3K punt TE (GSE 88) stacking the NO side of the MIN@NO game with Olave; 17.4 ceiling at 21% ownership proxy.

lineup.name: Raiders
lineup.why: $2.5K home DST vs NE (GSE 95); cheapest viable defense, paired with Bowers for LV game-script leverage.
